confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and drink anchors are the most reliable. Accommodation anchors, especially the hostel and 3-star figures, carry the widest uncertainty. July falls in the NSW winter school holidays, so accommodation may sit somewhat above off-season levels. The FX value comes from a search summary attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open the RBA CSV directly, so verify against the official F11.1 series before relying on it. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer price relationship because direct knowledge is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: Treated as a premium regional coastal tourist town in eastern Australia, benchmarked against other Northern NSW and Queensland coastal resort towns and Australian regional cafe and pub pricing. Accommodation reflects Byron's strong demand relative to typical regional towns.
